title: CardStateChanged
description: The card service publishes one CardStateChanged event whenever card state changes, and publishes nothing on a card list or a card read. Six payload fields carry the card after the change, with widths from the 150-byte card record at app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy. Five envelope fields precede them, and the envelope is additive in full: no source record carries one. Evolution is additive only: additionalProperties stays true, so a consumer validating against this version accepts an event that carries a field added by a later version. Inside one version no field is removed, renamed, retyped or narrowed; a change of that kind takes a new schemaVersion and a new -v<n> document beside this one.
$comment: CARD-CVV-CD PIC 9(03) at app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy:L7 is stored by the card service and appears in no property of this document, no log line and no response body. The 59-byte trailing FILLER at app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy:L11 carries no data and no field here maps to it.

eventId.description: The idempotency key. Each consumer records this identifier before it applies side effects. Additive. No source field exists.

eventType.description: The routing discriminator. A consumer reads this field to learn which payload arrived. Additive. No source field exists.

schemaVersion.description: The contract version. The number matches the -v1 suffix in this file name, and a later version only adds fields. Additive. No source field exists.

occurredAt.description: The publish timestamp, in Coordinated Universal Time. The card service stamps it when it writes the event to its outbox. Additive. No source field exists.

aggregateId.description: The account identifier the card belongs to, and always the Kafka message key. Width from CARD-ACCT-ID PIC 9(11) at app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy:L6. Keying on the account, and not on the card, keeps every event of one account on one partition and in order. The Kafka message key, this field and the payload field accountId all carry one value, so account identity has a single source. A publisher compares the key against this field and against accountId, and rejects the message on any difference.

accountId.description: The account identifier the card belongs to, eleven digits. From CARD-ACCT-ID PIC 9(11) at app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy:L6, which is also the alternate index the cross-reference dataset carries at app/jcl/XREFFILE.jcl:L72-L77. A text field keeps a leading zero.

changeType.description: What changed. CARD_UPDATED covers the card field update the online path performs, validated at app/cbl/COCRDUPC.cbl:L190-L202. Additive: the source publishes nothing and records no change type.

maskedCardNumber.description: The card number with twelve asterisks in place of the leading digits and the last four digits left visible. Position and width from CARD-NUM PIC X(16) at app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy:L5. The masking is additive: no source program masks a Primary Account Number, and app/bms/COCRDSL.bms:L96-L99 defines the card detail field at the full sixteen characters. A lookup runs on the full number and masking happens where the event is serialized.

embossedName.description: The name embossed on the card. From CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME PIC X(50) at app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy:L8.

expirationDate.description: The card expiry date, ten characters. From CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE PIC X(10) at app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy:L9, which the source spells with the transposed word. app/cbl/COCRDUPC.cbl:L117-L121 slices the field into a four-character year, a two-character month and a two-character day, which fixes the layout.

activeStatus.description: The one-character active status, carried through with no interpretation. From CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS PIC X(01) at app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy:L10. The batch posting program never opens the card dataset, so no consumer may decline on this field.
